title: 小费计算器
problem_statement_md:
当你出去吃饭时，通常需要给账单金额的20%小费。
但是，谁有时间每次都计算出正确的小费数额呢？
你肯定不会!当然可以编写一个程序来节省一些时间。

请写一个程序，输入账单金额，输出小费金额(浮点数)。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Tip Calculator[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

When you go out to eat, you always tip 20% of the bill amount. But who’s got the time to calculate the right tip amount every time? Not you that’s for sure! You’re making a program to calculate tips and save some time.

Your program needs to take the bill amount as input and output the tip as a [b]float[/b].

[b]Sample Input[/b]
50

[b]Sample Output[/b]
10.0

[note][b]Explanation[/b]: 20% of 50 is 10. 
To calculate 20% of a given amount, you can multiply the number by 20 and divide it by 100: [b]50*20/100 = 10.0[/b][/note]

testcases.explanation:
要计算一个给定数额的20%，你可以用这个数字乘以20再除以100。
**50*20/100 = 10.0**
